The aluminum film has a coefficient of thermal expansion α_f = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
The ceramic substrate has a coefficient of thermal expansion α_s = 8×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹.
The system is cooled by ΔT = 180 K.
Compute the thermal-mismatch strain using ε = (α_f − α_s) × ΔT.
The result is ε = (23×10⁻⁶ − 8×10⁻⁶) × 180 = 15×10⁻⁶ × 180 = 2.7×10⁻³.
State the final answer as 2.7×10⁻³ (dimensionless), noting that the film is in tension because it contracts more than the substrate upon cooling.
